newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Jindo to sell 100,000 common shares.
newsitem.headline: Jindo to sell 100,000 common shares.

text.p: Jindo Enterprise Co Ltd said on Thursday it would sell 100,000 common shares, or 3.11 percent of its share capital, to raise operational funds.
The company, a manufacturer of fur and leather garmets, will not own any of its own shares after the sale, a company statement said.
The shares will be sold on the open market between October 21 and January 20, 1997 at the previous day's closing price, the statement said.
The sale will be handled by Coryo Securities, Daewoo Securities, Kyobo Securities and Korea First Securities.
Jindo shares closed at 10,900 won on Thursday, down 500 from Wednesday.
